summary: Iteration 173 — Frontend-only testing of questionnaire card rendering for all 4 webstore types. All 12 acceptance criteria verified. Questionnaire card now shows for every store type (event, fundraiser, creator/team, business) with correct dynamic label, phase badge, and send/resend/view form buttons.
critical_code_review_comments: getQuestionnaireLabel() correctly handles event/fundraiser/creator/business store types (lines 95-104 in Webstores.js).
Questionnaire card at line 2667 renders for ALL store types — no store_type gate. Correct as per the fix.
questionnaire loading (line ~820-832) fetches for all store types without conditional gating — correct.
apply-answers-btn (data-testid) renders conditionally when questionnaireStatus.latest_response is truthy — code is correct but not UI-tested (no store with submitted response in test env).
Send dialog uses a fixed overlay (div.fixed.inset-0) rather than a proper Dialog component — this works fine but could have z-index conflicts with the parent Dialog. Not a functional issue.
seed_data_creation: None. Existing stores used for testing.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Questionnaire card now renders for ALL store types. All 4 types (event, fundraiser, creator, business) tested and passing. Event store with 'Sent' phase shows Resend + View Form buttons correctly. apply-answers-btn was not UI-tested due to no stores with submitted questionnaire responses in the test environment — but the code conditional is correct.
